value.rationale: The fixed-locus connected-component threshold is a natural first topological phase, rather than a small arbitrary additional Betti number. An infinite near-square construction supplies a structural mechanism for persistent isolated components of geometric fixed sets in a family whose underlying spaces are already known to be simply connected sphere bouquets. Neither counting ambient faces nor inspecting only self-conjugate graph vertices settles the claim.
